name: Overlord: Play Play Pleiades
overview: Get ready for a hilarious chibi adventure in "Overlord Ple Ple Pleiades"! Join the lovable and mischievous Pleiades maids as they serve up chaos and laughter in the quirky world of "Overlord." Watch Albedo, Shalltear, Aura, Mare, and the gang as they tackle everyday tasks with a twist! From planning epic parties to causing absolute mayhem, these chibi versions of your favorite characters will have you in stitches. But it's not all fun and games! When duty calls, the Pleiades show off their combat prowess with a side of silliness. Get ready for action-packed battles that will leave you cheering and laughing at the same time! "Overlord Ple Ple Pleiades" is the perfect blend of comedy, cuteness, and craziness. So buckle up for a wild ride with Ainz and his adorable minions as they embark on unforgettable misadventures that will tickle your funny bone and warm your heart. Don't miss out on this charming and fun-filled spin-off!
